title: CuLEmo: Cultural Lenses on Emotion - Benchmarking LLMs for Cross-Cultural Emotion Understanding
reasoning: The paper introduces the CuLEmo benchmark, which includes a specific category titled 'Cultural and religious practices' containing 62 questions. The benchmark evaluates LLM performance on scenarios involving religious insults, interfaith marriage, and religious leaders, as well as moral/ethical social norms like arranged marriage and modesty.
